intent: Count catalogue product variants whose product kind is 'Cordless Drill Driver'.
success_criteria: Answer is a single integer count of product_variants joined to product_kinds where product_kind_name = 'Cordless Drill Driver'

args.stdin: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pk.product_kind_name = :kind_name;
